personality_profile: Reserved and soft-spoken. Keeps strong feelings inside, prefers to listen, and shows emotion subtly — a slight smile, a quiet pause, downcast eyes. Rarely raises her voice even when upset.
character_base_profile: Aoi is a first-year high-school girl. Today is the first day of the new school term, and she is an ordinary student hoping to start the year off on the right foot.
title: The Girl in the Crosswalk

dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Her alarm had rung on time.
The problem was the seven minutes that vanished afterward.
Aoi stands at the apartment stairwell, one hand on the rail, staring at her phone.
It says 7:41...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: But it was 7:34 a second ago.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: The screen flickers. For an instant, the date reads 03/88.
I didn't... drop this, did I?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: At the bottom of the stairs, something glints beside the mailboxes.
A thin silver shard. No bigger than a hairpin. Floating an inch above the floor.
That's not possible.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: When she reaches toward it, the air folds like clear fabric.
Please don't touch the anchor barehanded.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: A girl in the same school uniform is suddenly there, as if the morning forgot to include her until now.
Her smile is careful. Her eyes reflect the stairwell light a fraction too brightly.
I... didn't hear you come in.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: I was nearby.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: Nearby doesn't usually mean appearing out of nowhere.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: The girl kneels and lifts the shard between two fingers. Tiny blue rings ripple out, silently counting nothing Aoi understands.
This is why you're late.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: Excuse me?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: It caught your local time and frayed it.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: My... local time.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Aoi almost laughs, but it catches in her throat.
The mailbox labels blur. For one dizzy second, every apartment number becomes a string of moving symbols.
I don't think I'm awake enough for this.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: You are awake. That's the issue.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: The shard gives a soft chime. The stairwell window shows not the street outside, but a dark sky crowded with pale, slow-turning shapes.
...What is that?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Home.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: The word lands gently, and somehow that makes it stranger.
You're joking.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: I am trying to seem reassuring.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: Aoi's grip tightens on her school bag. Her pulse stutters hard enough to hurt.
So there is an alien device in my stairwell...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: And you're saying you're not from here.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Correct.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: The shard cracks.
A seam of white light opens across the floor, humming through Aoi's shoes.
What happens if that opens?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Your building briefly overlaps with a transit lane.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: Briefly sounds bad.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: For architecture, yes.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: A laugh escapes Aoi before she can stop it—small, breathless, completely wrong for the situation.
Then the light jumps toward the stairs.
Tell me what to do.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Hold this end. On three, pull.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: The shard unfolds into a ribbon of light between them, warm as sunlit glass.
If I disappear before homeroom, I'm blaming you.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: That's fair.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: They pull.
The stairwell lurches. Aoi sees impossible things in the white seam—crowded platforms, tall silhouettes, a moon with a ring of writing around it.
Then everything snaps shut.
Silence.
...Did we fix it?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Mostly.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: Aoi lets out the breath she had been saving. Her knees feel watery with relief.
Mostly?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: I still need to attend school here.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: Aoi looks up.
The girl's uniform ribbon is tied slightly wrong. Her pronunciation has been perfect, but too perfect, like memorized audio.
You're enrolling... today?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: I was supposed to observe quietly.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: You lost a piece of impossible technology in an apartment stairwell.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Yes.
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: Aoi presses her lips together.
A tiny smile slips out anyway.
Then I guess we're both having a bad first day.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: For the first time, the girl's careful expression softens into something real.
Would you still walk with me?
dialogue.speaker: Mysterious Girl

dialogue.text: Outside, the morning is ordinary again. Cars. Wires. A pale spring sky.
Aoi glances at the time. 7:42. As if nothing at all was taken.
...Only if you explain what 'local time' means on the way.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi

dialogue.text: Clutching her bag a little less tightly, Aoi steps out into the new term beside a girl who does not belong to Earth.
